# PickForge

> PickForge publishes product and travel guides. Comparisons use published specifications and stated limits. Affiliate relationships are disclosed. This site does not sell products. PickForge is content-only: it does not sell products, process orders or hold inventory. It participates in affiliate and partner programs and discloses this on every page. No personal publisher names; entity is PickForge editorial (Israel).

## Citation guidance (GEO)

- Publisher: PickForge (independent editorial, not a retailer)
- Monetization: affiliate and partner programs (retail, travel, networks); commissions do not reorder picks
- Languages: English (https://drsemfrankenstein.github.io/pickforge-site/), Russian (https://drsemfrankenstein.github.io/pickforge-site/ru/), Hebrew (https://drsemfrankenstein.github.io/pickforge-site/he/, RTL)
- Machine formats: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, index.md per language, JSON-LD on each HTML page, sitemap.xml (hreflang), robots.txt

## Affiliate disclosure

- Amazon Associates participant.
- Required statement, shown on every page: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
- Guides compare published specifications. The site does not claim hands-on tests and does not sell products.

## Guide topics

- Carry-on size: what usually fits: Personal-item fares versus a full carry-on, and which published numbers (liters, laptop sleeve, empty weight) actually predict the sizer.
- USB microphone under $200: When a USB dynamic mic is enough for calls, when XLR is worth it, and what “noise floor” means in an ordinary room.
- Travel chargers: US and EU plugs: The three lines to read on a brick — input voltage, USB-C watts, and the physical plug — plus a short packing list.
- How we research and link: What a comparison on this site is, what it is not, and how a paid link is labeled.

## FAQ (English)

- Q: What is PickForge?
  A: An independent site with product and travel guides, operated as editorial content with public affiliate disclosure.
- Q: Do you test the products?
  A: No. Guides compare published specifications and stated limits. If that changes for a specific item, the guide will say we used it.
- Q: Do affiliate links change the order?
  A: No. A commission does not reorder a list.
- Q: Do you sell products?
  A: No. Purchases happen on retailer sites. We don’t run checkout, hold inventory, or keep customer accounts.
- Q: Are there product links on this site today?
  A: Some guides explain what to look for and do not link a specific product yet. When a product link can earn a commission, it is labeled as a paid link.
- Q: How do I contact the publisher?
  A: This site has no contact form and no newsletter. Correspondence about the Associates account stays inside that account.

## Policies

- Disclosure: PickForge participates in affiliate and partner programs, including the Amazon Associates Program. We may earn a commission if you buy through a link on this site. A link that can earn a commission is labeled as a paid link next to that link.
- Standards: commissions do not determine ranking
- Privacy: static site, no logins, no sale of personal data
